description: Create a discount code on the connected Shopify store: a percentage or a fixed amount off, on the whole store or on specific Spark items (each must be linked to a Shopify product), from a start day to an optional end day, with an optional total usage limit and once-per-customer rule. The code is open to every customer and does not combine with other discounts. The store must have "Let Spark create discount codes" turned on and Shopify's discount permission granted; the preview says what is missing when either is not. Dates are the account's local days (YYYY-MM-DD); the start defaults to today. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential with Write + storefront.execute and the Admin role. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies; nothing is sent to Shopify before that.

code.description: The code customers type at checkout, e.g. SPRING20. Letters, numbers, dashes or underscores; no spaces. Shopify ignores case.

endsOn.description: Last day the code works, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); omit for no end.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

itemIds.description: Spark item ids (GUIDs) the code applies to; omit for every product in the store. Find them with search_items.

oncePerCustomer.description: True to let each customer use the code only once.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

startsOn.description: First day the code works, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

title.description: The discount's name in Shopify admin; defaults to the code.

usageLimit.description: How many times the code can be used in total; omit for no limit.

value.description: The percent off (more than 0, at most 100) or the amount off in the store's currency.

valueType.description: "percentage" for a percent off, or "fixed_amount" for an amount off.

name: create_shopify_discount_code
title: Create Shopify Discount Code
